    shell-args: ["--norc", "--noprofile"]
    init: false

---

Bash is widely available and well-supported. quarto-term auto-detects the right `shell-args` (`--norc --noprofile`) when you set `shell: bash`.

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: bash
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
echo "Hello from bash $BASH_VERSION"
```

## Associative Arrays

```{term}
declare -A colors
colors=([red]="#ff0000" [green]="#00ff00" [blue]="#0000ff")
for name in "${!colors[@]}"; do
  echo "$name = ${colors[$name]}"
done
```

## Process Substitution

```{term}
diff <(echo -e "a\nb\nc") <(echo -e "a\nx\nc")
echo "(exit code: $?)"
```

## Here Strings

```{term}
while IFS=, read -r name age; do
  echo "$name is $age years old"
done <<< "Alice,30
Bob,25
Carol,35"
```
